# Threats that no concept anywhere in the ontology claims to neutralise.
#
# A sink carrying one of these cannot be cleared by any control, in any language,
# so the orphan check skips it. Closing one means deciding what a neutralising
# control for it is, writing the check concept, and binding it per language. Until
# then, a rule over such a sink can only report and never clear.
#
# One threat per line. Removing a line turns that threat into a build gate, so
# remove it only once a check concept for it exists.

concurrency.Toctou
crypto.IncompleteSecurityIdentifier
deserialization.UnsafeReflection
iac.PublicNetworkExposure
injection.ArgumentInjection
injection.CrlfInjection
injection.ExpressionLanguageInjection
injection.FormatString
injection.HttpResponseSplitting
injection.LogInjection
injection.MassAssignment
injection.ProtocolStateConfusion
injection.TemplateInjection
injection.UnrestrictedUpload
injection.UnsafeDynamicLoading
mobile.WebViewInjection
numeric.DivideByZero
path.LinkFollowing
session.SessionFixation
smartcontract.ExternalCallInjection
smartcontract.PrivilegedDestruct
